scope: Read-only actual Android Phone geometry export, not a production integration. Serialized active flags; does not execute runtime Board or FSM code.
coordinate_conversion: Retain original Unity coordinates; existing Godot importer reflects Z and conjugates rotations. No baked coordinate changes.
limitations: Actual Android PHONE static MeshRenderer scene; does not execute source PlayMaker/particle/audio state machines.
Original shader metadata retained; Godot shader adapters and framebuffer parity require separate validation.
Serialized scene activity is not a complete runtime frame.
identifier_encoding: All m_PathID/path_id values and otherwise unsafe integer metadata are decimal strings; fully qualified source IDs remain cab:path strings.
